findings.status: independent coaching concern; no promised deload-preservation invariant established
findings.expected: Following two RPE-8 easy runs, review whether the already scheduled imminent recovery week should remain at or below its original dose. This is a coaching expectation, not a documented phase-preservation guarantee.
findings.actual: Regeneration reindexes the phase: imminent W8 changes from deload=true, 40.2 km and zero quality to deload=false, 48.8 km and 3×45s T (2.25 min), a 21.4% volume increase. Deload is moved to W10 (Dec14-20), 36.6 km and zero quality. Original W12 deload (Dec28-Jan3), 40.2 km/zero quality, becomes non-deload 54.3 km/19.59 quality min (+35.1%). Initial remaining W7 dose and upcoming hard-work dose are reduced; faster pace proposals are correctly blocked.
